chunks: And provide for him from where he does not reckon. And whoever places his trust in God, He is sufficient for him. Certainly God fulfills His purpose. God has indeed fixed a measure of everything.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God provides from where one does not reckon?
ai.summary: This verse, central to the concept of Tawakkul (reliance on God), is frequently cited in Shia tradition as a source of comfort during times of hardship, emphasizing that divine sustenance (rizq) arrives from unforeseen avenues for those who place their trust in Allah. It underscores the principle that God's decree is absolute and precise, assuring believers that their needs are met according to a divinely ordained measure (qadr), thereby linking spiritual trust with cosmic order.
